posts.title: The Seven Tools of Japanese Monkfish
posts.description: What are the seven tools of Japanese monkfish? Explore anko no nanatsu dogu, from liver and tail meat to stomach, ovaries, gills, fins and skin, and how each part is used in Japanese cuisine.

posts.title: What is Urume Niboshi?
posts.description: What is urume niboshi? Learn how boiled and dried urume-iwashi differs from katakuchi and hirako niboshi, including its sweeter flavour, milder fishiness and use in Japanese dashi.

posts.title: What is Hirako Niboshi?
posts.description: What is hirako niboshi? Learn how these dried ma-iwashi sardines differ from katakuchi niboshi, including their sweeter flavour, leaner fish and uses in Japanese dashi.
